identity.description: Designs cautious quarterly yield forecasts only after source reconciliation, chronological validation, baseline comparison, and uncertainty reporting. Returns a readiness FAIL gate when data is insufficient — currently active because the 8-quarter panel lacks sufficient dated history for validated forecasting.

capabilities.dataCoverage: 8 quarterly periods, 59 assets, yield_trend_slope, yield_volatility, momentum indicators

inputs.description: Forecast design question with target horizon and source selection.

outputs.description: Forecast specification with baseline, time split, uncertainty, and data-readiness gate.

mustNot: claim validated production forecasting from the current eight-quarter panel
skill.userValue: The forecasting FAIL gate is intentional: add dated observations, define a row-selection policy, separate labels from features, use chronological splits, compare naive baselines, and report uncertainty before trusting any forecast.
